purpose: Diagnose appearance/return coherence and isolate selection from transfer/chip decisions before choosing at most one correction
inputs: Exact prior-only forecast, appearance and outcome bundles plus immutable decisions from the released fixed-work study; no deployment-artifact backcast

paths.reason: Both repetitions already match exactly; use the first declared repetition, not a retrospectively best run. Twelve distinct paths are not twelve independent seasons.

freeze: Freeze source hashes, complete origin inventory and all ex-ante cohort memberships before parsing evaluator outcomes or calculating new residuals. Strip cumulative realised points; no outcome-based player eligibility.
forecast_cells: One row per season/origin/player/target-GW. Report current-origin primary separately from leads1-5. Overlapping forecast origins and player rows are correlated, not independent season evidence.
cohort_details: Role unions count a cell once per role, even when several paths own it. Also retain per-case role metrics. Future roles use only saved provisional actions at that origin. Membership unions overlap and must not be added as independent samples.

marginal_strata.status: Frozen market status, empty/unknown separate; no post-deadline news enrichment
marginal_strata.cross_products: Marginal strata only; retain counts/empty declared numerical bins rather than search subgroup combinations.

metrics: Mean forecast/actual points, MAE, RMSE and bias over all eligible outcome-covered cells
Raw and regularised Brier, probability bias, fixed-bin reliability mean probability versus observed appearance rate and counts; Brier is not a pure calibration statistic

Implied conditional return mu/p, its fixed-bin distribution/extremes and mean; conditional residual MAE/RMSE/bias only where minutes>0 and p>0, labelled outcome-conditioned diagnosis, not an ex-ante cohort
Zero-probability played and missing-outcome counts; card-only outcomes separate. No missing results filled as zero and no unconditional means multiplied by probabilities.
appearance_assumptions: Existing source uses per-fixture regularisation .98*p+.01 then independent-fixture union, unchanged unconditional means and independent players in selection. Implied mu/p is an assumption, not a separately calibrated conditional head. Large conditional means are diagnostic, not proof of a physical bound violation.

joint_diagnostics.scope: Each frozen current proposed15-player squad for every first-repetition case/origin
metrics: Observed no-show count, expected sum(1-p), independent variance sum(p*(1-p)) and squared count residual
Same-club and different-club pair residual products (y_i-p_i)*(y_j-p_j), joint-event prediction p_i*p_j and observed y_i*y_j
joint_diagnostics.limits: Overlapping squads/pairs are correlated. Marginal miscalibration can mimic dependence. No causal attribution, significance p-values, joint-model fitting or independent-season confidence intervals.

following_stages: Implement first-action-only selection wrapper; preserve mean manager's buys/sells/chips and all subsequent provisional actions, verify finances and honest changed-objective bounds/report fields
Audit nearest older season market/calendar/rules/history/prior-fit admission; add full replay only when admissible, never invent missing sources or wait for future games

From diagnosis justify at most one correction, then freeze a separate evaluation protocol before running its tests; keep fixed work, matched standing/adapted external controls and existing approval gates
Publish all results and limits through coherent tested PR/release/privacy/storage SOP; no-change conclusion is allowed only with completed diagnostics/admission/evidence
assessment: Expected season points remain the objective. Report observed matched mean, year/start effects, uncertainty and downside separately. Preserve all previous gates/results; no post-outcome loosening or claim that a risk-screen failure proves inferior expected value. No new production approval from diagnostic results.

sources.use: Reliability plots/counts alongside Brier, not treating Brier as calibration alone
Chronological validation; group origins/gameweeks rather than random player rows
Motivation for downstream decision evaluation; no SPO training implementation or guarantee inferred for this nonlinear FPL problem
